name: Burkina Faso
title: LGBTQ rights in Burkina Faso
extract: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer (LGBTQ) people in Burkina Faso face severe legal challenges not experienced by non-LGBTQ residents. Since 1 September 2025, same-sex sexual acts and the promotion of same-sex sexual acts have been criminalised with severe legal penalties, while the pre-existing bans against same-sex marriage or adoption rights  remain in force.
